title: Clearances to combustible construction.
officialText:
Heat-producing equipment and appliances shall be installed to maintain the required
clearances to combustible construction as specified in the listing and manufacturer’s instructions. Such clearances shall be reduced only
in accordance with Section 308. Clearances to combustibles shall include such considerations as door swing, drawer pull, overhead
projections or shelving and window swing. Devices, such as door stops or limits and closers, shall not be used to provide the required
clearances.
